component.name: Omnicom
component.summary: Network management GUI with Serial, SSH, SNMP, VulnScan and Speed Test

description.p: Omnicom is a modern and elegant graphical interface for network device management. It combines multiple essential network tools into a single, unified PyQt6 application.

ul.li: Serial communication via picocom with automatic port detection
SSH and Telnet remote connections with connection profile management
Built-in TFTP server for firmware transfers
IP Scanner with ARP scanning and hostname resolution
SNMP browser for device monitoring
Traceroute / MTR with graphical route and latency visualization
Vulnerability Scanner using Nmap service detection and NVD CVE database
Speed Test via iPerf3 (LAN/WAN) or fast.com (Netflix CDN)
Wi-Fi network scanner

description.p: File Transfer tab, Serial quick connect overhaul, tab reorder, and About dialog

ul.li: New File Transfer tab: SSH/SFTP, SMB, FTP and TFTP protocols with server and client modes
SMB server configuration: Share Name, Comment, Workgroup, Valid Users, Guest access and Read-only fields
FTP server via pyftpdlib with pkexec support for privileged port 21
Transfer tab: collapsible log panel with timestamps and unified START/STOP button per protocol
Serial quick connect redesigned with grouped tree, drag-and-drop reordering, context menu and rename group — matching SSH quick connect
Vertical tab order reorganised: SSH, Serial, IP Scan, Traceroute, SNMP, WiFi Survey, Speed, Transfer
New About dialog accessible from sidebar with app description, author info, GitHub link and photo support
New official app icon: gradient O with C cutout (omnicom_icon.svg)
Scalable SVG icon installed in hicolor theme for all packaging formats
Serial tab: port type selector replaced with toggle buttons (USB / Serial)
Standardized button widths across all tabs (90px / 110px)
Speed tab: larger font for ISP, Country and Server labels; Country auto-populated via ip-api.com
All UI strings and code comments translated to English

description.p: Speed Test tab with iPerf3 and fast.com, Vulnerability Scanner improvements

ul.li: Add Speed Test tab combining iPerf3 and fast.com (Netflix CDN) modes
Real-time throughput graph with bitrate and cumulative transfer visualization
Post-test latency measurement via ping
iPerf3 public server list with country flags and quick-select dropdown
Vulnerability Scanner: Nmap integration for OS and service detection
CVE search via NVD API with CVSS severity badges and CSV export

description.p: Traceroute / MTR visualization and network improvements

ul.li: Add Traceroute / MTR tab with graphical route visualization
Redesign route visualization with glowing neon bars and hover effects
Redesign latency graph with premium dark/neon aesthetic
Add new icons for route graphics tab
Improve SNMP results table with context menu and clearer button labels
Enhance ARP scanning with hostname resolution and improved UI
Add automatic cap_net_raw capability configuration for traceroute binary
Optimize GUI layout and tab navigation

description.p: Vendor quick reference guide and UI improvements

ul.li: Add vendor quick reference guide dialog (click vendor icon in terminal)
Add new vendor icons: Linux, Aruba, MikroTik, Default
Fix D-Link vendor icon mapping
Improve dark theme styling for vendor selection menu and save dialogs

description.p: Project renamed from SerialCom to Omnicom

ul.li: Rename project from SerialCom to Omnicom
Add search functionality to terminal dialog with keyboard shortcuts
Add context menu with copy, paste, and export options to terminal widget
Add profile name banner and copy button for TFTP file names

description.p: Add vendor icons and UI improvements

ul.li: Add manufacturer SVG icons (Cisco, Huawei, Juniper, Fortinet, D-Link, H3C, Brocade, Datacom)
Display vendor icon next to equipment selector in terminal window
Update UI styling with grey/blue color palette
Improve TFTP interface combobox styling
Add Flatpak/Flathub support
Modern PyQt6 graphical interface
Automatic port detection with QSerialPortInfo
Full serial parameter configuration
Support for multiple terminal emulators
